name: Roseville Bridge
facts: Roseville Bridge opened on 2 April 1966, a six‑lane, high‑level marvel costing A$1.64 million, and was officially inaugurated by Premier Robin Askin alongside ministers Pat Morton, Milton Morris, Dick Healey, Harry Jago, and J. A. L. Shaw.
At 377 metres long and 17.4 metres high, the bridge’s clearance dwarfs the nearby Pipe Bridge, which offers only 11 metres, making the Roseville crossing the only practical route for most vessels.

In March 2022, heavy rain turned the bridge into a floating “Roseville Aqueduct,” with cars visibly bobbing on the water as drainage failed, a dramatic reminder of its low water depth and high traffic volume.
